content.text: Nigerian creators face a stark reality: Stripe, PayPal, and similar platforms are not options. This isn’t a temporary glitch—it’s a structural exclusion baked into global payment infrastructure. While others chase workarounds like VPNs or shell companies, sovereign commerce infrastructure provides a permanent alternative. It’s not about bypassing restrictions; it’s about owning the base layer. This analysis compares Stripe-dependent platforms to COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack, focusing on what each actually delivers. No hype. No victimhood. Just infrastructure facts.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Stripe alternatives

COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack offers a different architecture: GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto processing. It’s not a platform; it’s infrastructure. You own the code, the data, and the deployment. No platform locks you in. No subscriptions. No shutdown risks. The tradeoff? You manage the stack. But in return, you gain sovereignty—a structural advantage no platform can revoke.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal exclude Nigeria due to regulatory, fraud, and currency risks. This isn’t a technical issue; it’s a business decision. Workarounds like using a US-based friend’s account or VPNs are temporary and risky. They violate terms of service and can lead to account freezes. Sovereign commerce infrastructure sidesteps this entirely. By using open-source tools and on-chain crypto payments, it operates outside the jurisdiction of any single platform or country. The Edge Commerce Stack deploys on GitHub Pages and Cloudflare—infrastructure available globally. Payments process through NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies without KYC. This isn’t a hack; it’s a redesign of the base layer.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe charges 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction, but Nigerian creators can’t access it. Crypto payments via NOWPayments charge 0.5% with no monthly fees. Transaction costs on BSC, Solana, or TRON networks are under $0.10. The Edge Commerce Stack automates payment verification and product delivery the moment a transaction confirms on-chain—no waiting for bank settlements. The real cost? Time to deploy and maintain the stack. But this is an investment in ownership, not a recurring fee. Compare this to platforms that charge monthly subscriptions or take a cut of every sale. With sovereign infrastructure, the economics flip in your favor over time.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure is ownership, not dependency.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Stripe-dependent platforms own your data, your customer relationships, and your ability to operate. They can suspend your account or change their terms at any time. The Edge Commerce Stack inverts this. You own the GitHub repository, the Supabase database, and the Cloudflare Workers code. Product delivery happens automatically via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2—no third-party delivery platforms required. Email confirmations are handled through your own configured SPF/DKIM/DMARC records, ensuring deliverability. This isn’t just automation; it’s autonomy. Your stack runs independently of any platform’s whims.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you prioritize convenience over control, Stripe-dependent platforms might seem appealing—until they’re not available. For Nigerian creators, this isn’t a choice. Sovereign commerce infrastructure is the only structural solution. The Edge Commerce Stack is built for creators who value ownership over ease. It’s deployed in 48 hours, comes with 5 products pre-loaded, and includes 30-day support. It’s not a workaround; it’s a foundation. If you’re selling digital products and need to own your infrastructure, this is the architecture to choose. It’s pressure-tested in Zimbabwe, where currency collapse and payment rejection are the norm. It works where platforms fail.

Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use the Edge Commerce Stack if I’m not technical?

Yes. The stack is deployed and configured by COREMERCH. You provide your product details, and they handle the technical setup. After deployment, basic maintenance requires minimal technical knowledge.
What cryptocurrencies does NOWPayments support?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Binance Coin, and stablecoins like USDT. Recommended networks for low fees are BSC, Solana, and TRON.
How does product delivery work?
Products are stored on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Once payment is verified, the stack automatically sends a download link to the customer’s email. No manual intervention required.
What happens if a payment fails?
The stack uses NOWPayments’ automatic webhook to verify transactions. If a payment fails, the customer is not granted access to the product. You can manually refund or resend the product if needed.
Can I scale this stack as my business grows?
Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack is designed for scalability. You can add more products, upgrade to a dedicated server, or integrate additional tools as your business expands.
